_comment: PLACEHOLDER values: re-measure on site with a tape (±0.5 m is enough). START frame = vehicle pose when PX4 first reports armed: forward = its heading, left, up; metres. Angles in degrees counter-clockwise from forward (90 = left). Load with mission.core.CoursePrior.load(path).

fence._comment: Net cage ~6.1 x 6.1 x 3.0 m. Measure the start position against two net walls; setpoints stay fence_margin_m inside, the vehicle trips stop+land fence_inset_m inside.

corridor._comment: stage 1 = 3-lane serpentine (left lane front->back, right turn behind the middle board, middle lane back->front, right turn in front of the right board, right lane front->back). Give the END of each lane, on the lane centre line and in the MIDDLE of the ~1.1 m turn gap; the mission inserts the perpendicular crossing at each U-turn itself (or list the red line's corners explicitly). The last leg ends at the tunnel standoff automatically.

tunnel._comment: entry = centre of the first brass hoop (up = hoop centre height), axis_deg = direction through the tunnel, length_m = first hoop to last hoop

window._comment: centre of the rectangular opening in the tan board; through_deg = direction of travel through it

landing_target._comment: blue H landing pad (~0.6 m square) lying FLAT on the floor: centre of the pad; top_up = 0 (the floor)

wall._comment: cross_from is a floor point on the landing-pad side of the wall, cross_to on the home side; the segment must cross the wall. top_up = wall top height (prior; a fresh depth measurement can only raise it).
